# tossctl operations

127 operations, grouped by category. Each is callable by `id` via `call_operation` (MCP) or `tossctl ops call <id>`. Always confirm the current parameter schema with `describe_operation` before calling — this list is a map, not the contract.

Columns: **backend** = credential channel (`wts` web session · `official` Open API · `auto` either · `none` local); **write** = mutates state (preview-then-confirm, gated); **required** = params you must pass.

## account

| id | backend | write | required | summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_access_status` | wts |  |  | User-global last Toss Securities login context plus account-specific margin-freeze and accident-account signals. Read-only; does not unlock or modify the account. |
| `account_commission` | wts |  |  | Commission schedule this account is charged, per market (KR equities, US equities, US options). Distinct from quote_commission, which is per-symbol. |
| `account_detail` | wts |  |  | Account identity, withdrawal capacity and credit-trading status (read-only half of 계좌관리): number, name, status, dates; withdrawable cash by settlement day (D+0/1/2) with caps and usage; 미수거래 per market. Full account number and holder name are returned — do not echo them into shared output. |
| `account_interest` | wts |  |  | Deposit-interest (예탁금 이용료) payments for a year: date, pre-tax, tax, net, accrual period, estimate flag. profit_summary type=account-interest is the period total. |
| `account_overview` | wts |  |  | All-account asset rollup, including minor accounts and pending-order counts. Account numbers are masked unless full=true. |
| `account_receivable` | wts |  |  | Receivable (미수금) and forced-liquidation warning state for one currency: amount owed, payment deadline, liquidation time, and any trading-suspension window. All timestamps are null on a healthy account. |
| `account_summary` | wts |  |  | Account summary (balance, holdings valuation, P&L). |
| `accounts` | wts |  |  | List brokerage accounts. |
| `buying_power` | wts |  | currency | Cash buying power for a currency. |
| `holdings` | wts |  |  | Current stock holdings; optionally filter by symbol. |
| `lending_expected` | wts |  |  | Projected share-lending (대주) income for the account — monthly/yearly USD totals plus per-stock breakdown. Works even without an active lending agreement (zeros). |
| `lending_top_revenue` | wts |  |  | Anonymized share-lending revenue ranking in server order. |
| `positions` | wts |  |  | Current holdings with valuation and unrealized P&L (works without an official key). |
| `prime_status` | wts |  |  | Toss Prime subscription status and this month's fee/interest benefits. |
| `securities_transfer_accounts` | wts |  |  | Own and recent destination accounts from the Securities stock-transfer flow. Read-only; account numbers are masked unless full=true. WTS-only; not general Toss Banking. |
| `tax_ria` | wts |  |  | RIA (해외주식 양도세 절세 계좌) report: estimated capital-gains tax before/after the deduction, quarterly components, sell limit, remaining saving. Complements tax_overseas. Mobile-app-only. |
| `transaction_ledger` | wts |  |  | One page of the KR+US transaction ledger, unsettled first; from/to are settlement dates. Unsigned decimal amounts; type and is_cancellation give direction. Pages can be empty: follow has_next. |
| `transactions` | wts |  |  | Detailed transaction list (deposits/withdrawals/trades) aggregated across pages over a date range. |
| `transactions_overview` | wts |  |  | Transaction history overview (deposits/withdrawals/trades summary). |

## history

| id | backend | write | required | summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `history_compare` | none |  | before, after | Compare holdings in two local collections: added/removed positions, quantity and valuation deltas. Value changes include trades and FX and are not investment returns. Offline. |
| `history_list` | none |  |  | List local WTS collections, including freshness, date coverage, and completeness. Offline; no credentials required. |
| `history_positions` | none |  |  | Holdings from one local WTS collection. Historical observations, never live balances. Offline. |
| `history_sync` | wts | yes |  | Preview a local SQLite append of current WTS holdings and dated transactions. Execute only with the fresh preview confirm token. Writes local history only; does not trade or change the account. Incomplete transaction paging is explicitly labeled. |
| `history_transactions` | none |  |  | Search a local transaction collection by literal substring in symbol, stock name, category, or summary. Preserves currencies and coverage metadata. Collections are not merged; default latest. Offline. |

KR after_market is the KRX/NXT union (absent only if both close); its single_price_auction_end is NXT-based and omitted if NXT closes. KR pre/post closing-price sessions excluded; US includes day_market. |
| `market_events` | wts |  |  | One month of market events: economic releases (forecast, actual, prior), KR/US earnings with symbol and call time, holidays. month is YYYY-MM (default: current). Weekly AI summary only for the present month. |

| `market_issues` | wts |  |  | Ranked market topics, rank movement (UP/DOWN), article counts and articles. Unlike market_news headlines or news_briefing AI groups, this returns topic rankings. No parameters. |

| `news_briefing` | wts |  |  | Personalized AI briefing enriched with the related holding/watchlist asset, return, signal direction, reasoning title, and source headlines. |

| `quote_option_chain` | wts |  | symbol, expiry | Call/put option chain for one expiration: every strike with the contract identifiers and open interest on each side. Carries no prices. Get valid expiry values from quote_option_expiries. |
| `quote_option_expiries` | wts |  | symbol | Listed expiration dates for a US underlying's options, with each one's liquidation time. Pick one and pass it to quote_option_chain. |
| `quote_reasoning` | wts |  | symbol | Toss's AI explanation of why a stock moved today, plus the stocks it cites as connected. Narrative, unlike quote_signals which is short signal cards. |

| `sectors` | wts |  |  | Sector movement (39 top-level sectors, 1d/1mo/1y returns). |
| `stock_ranking` | wts |  |  | Realtime popularity ranking (most-viewed stocks). |
| `stock_supply` | wts |  | symbol | KR daily investor flows (7-way institutions, foreign holdings, CFD), short selling, credit, lending or program trades; cursor pagination. Unavailable fields are omitted, distinct from zero. Short rates are decimal ratios of daily totals including pre/post-market closing-price sessions and after-market. |

## order

| id | backend | write | required | summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto_trades` | wts |  |  | Automated-trading rules armed on the account (STOP_LOSS, PROFIT_RATE, OCO, OTO) with trigger/order prices. Read-only — arm/cancel in the app. status is the enum name, status_code the raw code. |
| `cancel_conditional_order` | wts | yes | conditional_order_id | Cancel a conditional order. Gated; preview unless execute=true. |
| `cancel_order` | wts | yes | order_id, symbol | Cancel a pending order. Gated; preview unless execute=true. |
| `completed_orders` | wts |  |  | Completed orders, including canceled orders, with average execution price and executed quantity. Defaults to the current month; all_dates reads unified history without a date filter. |
| `conditional_order` | wts |  | conditional_order_id | Fetch one conditional order by id. |
| `conditional_orders` | wts |  |  | List conditional orders. Returns one page; pass next_cursor back as cursor when has_next is true. |
| `modify_conditional_order` | wts | yes | conditional_order_id, quantity, expire_date, first_side, first_trigger | Modify a WATCHING/PAUSED conditional order. Gated; preview unless execute=true. Returns a new id; the old one stops working. |
| `modify_order` | wts | yes | order_id | Modify a pending order's quantity/price. Gated; preview unless execute=true. |
| `order` | wts |  | order_id | One Open API-supported order by id. Unsupported types, including pre/post-market closing-price orders, are absent as in the list. |
| `order_funding` | wts |  |  | Whether buying is possible right now and, when blocked, the deposit or exchange amount still required. Reports the gap, unlike account_summary which reports what is already orderable. |
| `orders` | wts |  |  | One page of Open API-supported orders. While has_next, pass next_cursor as cursor. Unsupported types, including pre/post-market closing-price orders, are absent from lists and detail; empty results do not prove no orders exist. |
| `pending_orders` | wts |  |  | Open (unfilled) pending orders (works without an official key). |
| `place_conditional_order` | wts | yes | symbol, quantity, expire_date, first_side, first_trigger | Place a conditional order. Gated; preview unless execute=true. |
| `place_order` | wts | yes | symbol, side | Place a new order (US/KR, limit or US fractional market). Gated; preview unless execute=true. |
| `sellable_quantity` | auto |  | symbol | Sellable quantity for a symbol. Served by either backend (official first, web-session fallback). |

## portfolio

| id | backend | write | required | summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accumulation_plans` | wts |  |  | All stock-accumulation (주식모으기) recurring-buy plans on the account — which stocks, Active vs Paused, amount/quantity, frequency, rounds completed. |
| `accumulation_status` | wts |  | symbol | Stock-accumulation (주식모으기) plan(s) for one stock — Active vs Paused, amount/quantity, frequency. |
| `dividends` | wts |  |  | Annual dividend history (received/scheduled, by region, monthly). |
| `hidden_holding_hide` | wts | yes | symbol | Preview or hide a holding in the Securities portfolio. Execution requires execute=true and the fresh confirm_token. |
| `hidden_holding_show` | wts | yes | symbol | Preview or show a holding in the Securities portfolio. Execution requires execute=true and the fresh confirm_token. |
| `hidden_holdings` | wts |  |  | List holdings hidden from a Securities portfolio. Account identifiers are not returned. |
| `portfolio_briefing` | wts |  |  | One read combines current holdings with their upcoming earnings calls, newest holdings news, and matching pending orders. Partial failures are labeled per section; this is not an atomic account snapshot. |
| `portfolio_folders` | wts |  |  | Grouped Securities holdings with default and user-defined folders, fees, and after-fee returns for one account. Session-bound folder and item keys are not returned. |
| `portfolio_performance` | wts |  |  | One-month daily portfolio valuation trend: principal, evaluated amount, return, range high/low, and realtime point. Omit account for the all-account aggregate. WTS-only; no web UI. |
| `portfolio_snapshot` | wts |  | date | Complete dated valuation by market (KR stocks, US stocks, US options, bonds) and holding. Omit account for all accounts. WTS-only; no web UI. |
| `portfolio_snapshots` | wts |  |  | Cursor page of dated portfolio valuations with principal, evaluated amount, profit/loss, return, and completeness. Omit account for all accounts. WTS-only; no web UI. |
| `profit_daily` | wts |  |  | Per-stock realized profit day by day — symbol, quantity, P/L, return rate, sell/buy amounts, all pages combined. currency selects the RATE BASIS (KRW folds in FX, USD does not), not a filter. |
| `profit_overview` | wts |  |  | Cumulative realized profit across every category — trading gains, dividends, share-lending, maturity, deposit interest — each in KRW and USD. A cumulative view distinct from account summary (current valuation). |
| `profit_period` | wts |  |  | Realized profit for ONE category over a date range — earned amount, return rate, and purchase basis in KRW and USD. Omit from/to for the whole history. The period-scoped counterpart to profit_overview (all-time, every category). |
| `tax_overseas` | wts |  |  | Overseas-stock transfer income (해외주식 양도소득) for a tax year — tax summary (rate, deduction, tax due) plus per-stock profit/loss. For capital-gains tax filing (KRW). |
| `watchlist_news` | wts |  | folder_id | Recommended news for one existing watchlist folder, with related stock moves. One server-limited page. |

## quote

| id | backend | write | required | summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quote_charts` | wts |  | symbols | Batch intraday candles, server-selected range/step (observed 1d/10m). Use quote_chart to select an interval. Found rows keep requested order; omitted symbols appear in missing. |
| `quote_reasons` | wts |  | symbols | Batch one-line AI explanations (web uses up to 100 symbols). Full single-stock card: quote_reasoning. Found rows keep requested order; omitted symbols appear in missing. |

## settings

| id | backend | write | required | summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notification_settings` | wts |  |  | Every WTS notification preference and its enabled state, including upstream untyped rows. Read-only; internal user ids are omitted. |
| `notification_status` | wts |  |  | Inbox and selected AI/FOMC notification states summarized from the generic settings list, plus reasoning agreement and a deprecated global news-count field. Read-only. |
| `openapi_ip_list` | wts |  |  | List IP addresses allowed to call the official Open API. Requires a WTS web session; returns no API key or secret. |
| `openapi_ip_replace_current` | wts | yes |  | Replace the official Open API allowlist with this machine's current public IP. Preview by default; execution requires execute=true and the preview confirm_token. Verifies every mutation and reconciles the previous allowlist on failure. |
| `trading_settings` | wts |  |  | Read-only Securities trading preferences: account-specific simple trade plus user-wide KRX/NXT execution venue, ATS notifications, and option real-time tick subscription flags. WTS-only; not general Toss Banking. |
